title: Variables and environments
brief: Where and how ReqFlux edits environments and variables: environment list with create, rename and delete; variables with initial vs current values, enabled toggle, secrets in the OS keyring, collection-scope variables and undeclared current values. Built on the Bolt shell of design/bolt-v2.

artboards.title: Workspace settings page
artboards.tradeoff: Refines bolt-v2/03: full table with room for initial, current, storage and description, collection scopes in the settings nav; editing is modal, so the request is hidden while you change a value

artboards.title: Sidebar panel
artboards.tradeoff: Edit next to the open request (rail entry, all scopes in one list, inline delete confirmation); 300 px forces two-line rows and one expanded editor at a time, no room for descriptions

artboards.title: Scope matrix document
artboards.tradeoff: Variables as a document tab: keys by scopes shows overrides and what staging resolves to at a glance, with an inspector for the selected cell; gets wide past five or six environments and hides descriptions
